brief: Create the opening of a realistic short film inspired by the VideoClaw showcase "A laid-off programmer uses OpenClaw to acquire his former company", episode 1 "Laid Off". One episode, a 15-second silent visual excerpt. Exactly three shots of 5 seconds, one office location, two characters: a young East Asian programmer in a grey hoodie and black rectangular glasses, and a female HR manager in a navy blazer. Shot 1: the programmer sits at his desk; the manager quietly places a closed plain envelope beside his keyboard. Shot 2: close view of the programmer looking at the envelope, then closing his laptop. Shot 3: he carries a small cardboard box toward the office exit, pauses and looks forward with resolve. Daylight, restrained realistic acting, consistent clothing and faces. No readable text, no dialogue, no voiceover, no music. Do not add characters or events.
